method: Lossless row split of one existing RGBA source into upper TEXT_LABELS_HEADER and lower TEXT_BOTTOM_ACTIONS; retain all visible source channel bytes, disjoint alpha, no font/render changes. In new 73-layer manifest place upper before COUNTER_FRONT and lower after button bases/icons before BTN_CONFIRM_TEXT. Preserve old v0.1/v0.2 artifacts byte-for-byte.
first_output_gate: 73-layer PSD readable and RGB preview exactly equal to frozen v0.2 neutral reconstructed PNG before any GIF or sheet expansion.

budget.release_condition: Matching Tech presign and proven updated remaining activity balance; reduce actual candidate cap when needed.

stop_rule: No image before same-batch Tech sign/budget release; one candidate only. Any visible RGBA change, 73-layer order/read failure, nonzero neutral RGB diff, out-of-scope visual change, or activity cap exceed stops without automatic retry. Gate2 and Client import remain separate.
